reconciliations.delirium: Separate screening from diagnosis, general care from rescue medication, and NICE short-term symptom control from PADIS ICU evidentiary uncertainty.
reconciliations.four_at: Correct attention category mismatch and reject invalid counts without silent truncation; no claim of whole-score-catalog validation or new UI deployment.
reconciliations.withdrawal: Use one selected ASAM loading example and current UK risk-stratified thiamine reference; do not stack alternative schedules. Older ASAM prophylactic thiamine dose differs from selected UK guidance, not a Wernicke treatment substitute.
reconciliations.consciousness: Etiology-driven investigation, ACR imaging context and selective antidotes. ASAM permits glucose/thiamine in either order; older ENLS4 coma source identified but not adopted for a thiamine-before-glucose rule.
